methodologyNotes: Published self-serve USD pricing was collected from each vendor's official site where accessible. SimpliSafe, Ring Alarm, ADT, Vivint, Cove, and Frontpoint either blocked automated access (403/404) or render pricing behind JS builders; their figures were sourced from reputable 2026 pricing-comparison sources (safewise.com and bobvila.com) and cross-corroborated between the two. Abode's official pricing page (goabode.com/plans) rendered live and was read directly. For home-security products, monthlyUsd = the recurring monitoring fee; one-time equipment/hardware costs are recorded in setupFeeUsd and notes. minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall are null throughout (non-telephony vertical). Quote-only or contact-sales tiers are recorded with monthlyUsd null.

vendors.name: SimpliSafe
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page simplisafe.com blocked automated access; pricing sourced from safewise.com and security.org SimpliSafe cost pages (2026). Verified 2026-06-14: Self-Monitoring with Video $9.99, Standard $22.80, Pro $49.99, Pro Plus $79.99 all corroborated. Core corrected from $31.99 to $32.99 (security.org; safewise lists $33.99) as the original $31.99 matched no credible source.

plans.name: Self-Monitoring (No Video)
plans.notes: App-based self-monitoring only; no professional dispatch. No video storage. Equipment sold separately (starter kits from ~$249).

plans.name: Self-Monitoring with Video
plans.notes: Self-monitoring with live video and video storage via SimpliSafe app. No professional dispatch. Equipment sold separately.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: 24/7 professional monitoring with cellular backup. Approximately $0.76/day. Equipment sold separately (starter kits from ~$249). No long-term contract.

plans.name: Core
plans.notes: 24/7 professional monitoring plus live video and video recording access. Equipment sold separately. No contract. Price corrected to $32.99 (confirmed by security.org and safewise.com 2026); the previously listed $31.99 matched no credible source.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Includes Active Guard live-agent video verification 8pm–6am on top of standard professional monitoring and video. Equipment sold separately. No contract.

plans.name: Pro Plus
plans.notes: 24/7 Active Guard live-agent video verification (around-the-clock, not just overnight). Highest SimpliSafe tier. Equipment sold separately. No contract.

vendors.name: ADT
vendors.provenance: ADT official site (adt.com) returned 403 Forbidden. Pricing sourced from safewise.com/home-security-review/adt-home-security review (2026) which lists five named plan tiers by monthly price. ADT Self Setup tier ($19.99/mo) confirmed by safewise.com/home-security-review/adt-self-setup and safewise.com/best-home-security-systems. Equipment and installation from bobvila.com best-home-security-systems.

plans.name: Self Setup
plans.notes: ADT Self Setup DIY system. Month-to-month, no contract. 24/7 professional monitoring via ADT-owned centers. Equipment purchased separately upfront. 30-day return window.

plans.name: Landline
plans.notes: Professional installation required ($99–$199). Traditional landline monitoring. 36-month contract typical. Equipment included with monthly plan.

plans.name: Entry
plans.notes: Professional installation required ($99–$199). Cellular connectivity. Mobile app access. 36-month contract typical.

plans.name: Low
plans.notes: Professional installation required ($99–$199). Adds live video monitoring capability. 36-month contract typical.

plans.name: Mid
plans.notes: Professional installation required ($99–$199). Smart home automation integration. 36-month contract typical.

plans.name: High (Video & Control)
plans.notes: Highest ADT tier. Professional installation required. Includes Google Nest cameras, full video monitoring, and smart home automation. 36-month contract typical. Quality Service Plan extended warranty included.

vendors.name: Ring Alarm
vendors.provenance: Ring official site (ring.com/pages/alarm-monitoring, ring.com/pages/subscriptions) returned 404. Pricing verified 2026-06-14 against security.org/home-security-systems/ring-alarm. Ring rebranded its tiers: the plan names previously recorded here (Standard/Premium) are stale. Current self-serve tiers are Ring Multi ($9.99, no professional monitoring) and Ring AI Pro ($19.99, the tier that includes 24/7 professional monitoring). Virtual Security Guard add-on confirmed at $99/mo.

plans.name: Ring Multi
plans.notes: Covers all Ring cameras and doorbells on the account with video recording and rich notifications. Does NOT include 24/7 professional alarm monitoring (that requires Ring AI Pro). DIY setup, no contract. Corrected 2026-06-14: previously mislabeled 'Standard' and wrongly attributed professional monitoring.

plans.name: Ring AI Pro
plans.notes: Includes 24/7 professional monitoring for the Ring Alarm system, cellular backup, extended video history, and AI features. DIY setup, no contract. Equipment kits sold separately. Corrected 2026-06-14: previously labeled 'Premium'; this $19.99 tier (not the $9.99 tier) is the one carrying professional monitoring.

plans.name: Virtual Security Guard Add-on
plans.notes: Add-on requiring an underlying paid Ring plan. Live trained security agents monitor camera feeds on demand and respond to alerts. Price $99/mo confirmed 2026-06-14 via security.org.

vendors.name: Abode
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page goabode.com/plans rendered live content and was read directly on 2026-06-14. Plan names, monthly prices, and annual prices confirmed from the official page. Annual prices cross-checked against goabode.com/security-plans (which returned same figures). Corroborated by safewise.com/best-home-security-systems.

plans.name: No Subscription
plans.notes: Full app access, live video streaming, push notifications, smart home integrations (Apple HomeKit, Alexa, Google Home). No professional monitoring. Free forever. Equipment sold separately.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: Month-to-month $8.49/mo; annual $79.99/yr (~$6.67/mo, ~21% savings). Adds 30-day event history, AI smart detection, rich notifications, insurance discount eligibility. Self-monitoring only — no professional dispatch. No contract.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Month-to-month $26.99/mo; annual $245.99/yr (~$20.50/mo, ~24% savings). Adds 24/7 professional monitoring, 4G cellular backup, automatic emergency dispatch. Up to 30% insurance discount. No contract.

plans.name: On-Demand (3-Day)
plans.notes: One-time purchase of 3 days of professional monitoring for $8. Not a recurring subscription — priced as a one-time activation. Available to users on the No Subscription or Standard tier.

plans.name: On-Demand (7-Day)
plans.notes: One-time purchase of 7 days of professional monitoring for $15. Not a recurring subscription. Available to users on the No Subscription or Standard tier.

vendors.name: Vivint
vendors.provenance: Vivint official site returned 404 and Vivint does not publish self-serve pricing — monitoring is quote-configured. Verified 2026-06-14: credible sources do not agree and none confirm the previously listed $29.99/mo. security.org reports Basic Monitoring $24.99 / Premium Monitoring $49.99; safewise reports the basic tier was retired with current plans starting at $39.99/$44.99. Because no credible source confirms a single self-serve figure, monthlyUsd is set to null (quote-only).

plans.name: Smart Home Monitoring (quote-only)
plans.notes: Quote-configured professional monitoring; not self-serve. Reported entry monthly figures vary widely across 2026 sources ($24.99 on security.org vs $39.99 on safewise) and the previously listed $29.99 appears to be a retired tier — set to null pending a confirmable self-serve price. Professional installation required ($49 minimum). Equipment starter pack purchased upfront or financed; multi-year contract if financed.

vendors.name: Cove
vendors.provenance: Cove official site (covesmart.com/plans, covesmart.com/monitoring-plans) returned 404; homepage returned no pricing. Pricing sourced from safewise.com/home-security-review/cove review which explicitly names Cove Basic at $19.99/mo and Cove Plus at $27.99/mo; corroborated by safewise.com/best-home-security-systems listing the same figures. Equipment pricing from safewise.com review.

plans.name: Cove Basic
plans.notes: 24/7 professional monitoring with mobile app access. No video features included. 1-year equipment warranty. DIY setup; professional installation available for $79. Equipment purchased separately (~$300 for starter kit). No long-term contract.

plans.name: Cove Plus
plans.notes: 24/7 professional monitoring plus video integration, mobile app, and 1 day of cloud video storage per camera. Lifetime warranty on all Cove devices. DIY or professional install ($79). No contract. Economy Plan financing option adds $10/mo over 36 months.

vendors.name: Frontpoint
vendors.provenance: Frontpoint official site monitoring page (frontpointsecurity.com/monitoring) returned partial content listing plan tiers with daily rates. Exact monthly equivalents and plan names cross-confirmed by safewise.com/home-security-review/frontpoint (2026) which lists the same three tiers at $15/mo, $45/mo, and $49.20/mo. Equipment package prices from bobvila.com.

plans.name: Self-Monitoring with Video
plans.notes: App-based self-monitoring with live and recorded video. No professional dispatch. Mobile app control. ~$0.50/day. Equipment sold separately (essential package ~$415, total package ~$1,125).

plans.name: Interactive
plans.notes: 24/7 professional monitoring for intrusion, fire, CO, and flood. Mobile app control, battery backup, automatic hourly system checks. ~$1.48/day. 3-year contract online; month-to-month by phone. Professional installation available via HelloTech ($99).

plans.name: Ultimate
plans.notes: Everything in Interactive plus video monitoring with analytics, home automation (smart locks, lights, thermostat), pet protection, and crash & smash safety. ~$1.65/day. 3-year contract online; month-to-month by phone.
